title: Implement HDR command (RFC 3977 §8.5)
description: reader/session/response.rs:76: CAPABILITIES advertises HDR. dispatch.rs:153: any unmatched command falls through to information_follows(), which is not correct HDR handling. RFC 3977 §8.5 defines the HDR command. Clients seeing HDR in CAPABILITIES will attempt to use it and receive nonsense. Fix: either implement HDR or remove it from CAPABILITIES.
design: Decision: implement, not remove. HDR is used by Thunderbird and current clients when advertised in CAPABILITIES. Implementation: same article retrieval path as OVER but returns a single named header field per article. Advertise as 'HDR' in CAPABILITIES. Support both range and message-id forms per §8.5.
